description: This donut chart, a variation of a pie chart, illustrates the proportional distribution of various categories under the central, bolded heading "Stimulus Type." The chart is divided into ten distinct slices, each representing a specific stimulus category. Moving clockwise from the top right, the segments include Draft/Other in dark red (26.4%), Event Posting in dark brown (6.6%), Organizational Report in mauve (7.7%), Organizational Website in light purple (4.9%), Interview in dark navy blue (8.8%), Intra-agency news article in medium blue (4.9%), External News Article in dark green (18.1%), Email in light green (2.7%), Press Release in gold (18.7%), and a very thin slice for Social Media Post in orange (1.1%). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels and their corresponding exact percentages are positioned directly outside their respective slices. Visually, the segments do not appear to be arranged in any specific size-based order, such as ascending or descending, and none of the individual slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting.
